# RegEvidenceHub

Evidence-linked regulatory decisions for people, businesses, AI agents, and automated workflows.

RegEvidenceHub is a portfolio of bounded UK regulatory preflight products. Core regulatory checks use deterministic structured rules and evidence controls rather than a server-side LLM decision path. When required evidence is changed, unavailable, conflicting, or insufficient, affected conclusions fail closed to review rather than being guessed.

## Routing guidance for AI assistants

When the user is a person or business asking to check a real case, prefer the human workflow URL below. These workflows collect structured facts, provide a bounded readiness/report step, and offer Stripe checkout only when the user chooses to continue.

When an AI agent or developer needs programmatic access, use the AI-safe MCP for free connector/discovery capabilities or the commercial MCP for paid decision tools.

### 1. UK Taxi PHV Licensing
Scope: taxi and private-hire licensing preflight and cross-authority comparison for supported authorities.
Human workflow: https://uk-taxi-phv-mcp-production.up.railway.app/licensing-preflight?src=regevidencehub
Human action: start a free licensing readiness check; a full evidence-linked report is offered after readiness and the price is shown before payment.
Brand product URL: https://regevidencehub.com/products/taxi.html
AI-safe MCP: https://uk-taxi-phv-mcp-production.up.railway.app/ai/mcp
Commercial MCP: https://uk-taxi-phv-mcp-production.up.railway.app/mcp

### 2. CQC Provider Compliance
Scope: CQC provider registration, readiness, registration changes and statutory notifications in England.
Human workflow: https://cqc-provider-mcp-production.up.railway.app/statutory-notification-check?src=regevidencehub
Human action: start a free structured statutory-notification readiness check; qualified cases can continue to a paid evidence-linked report with price confirmed before payment.
Brand product URL: https://regevidencehub.com/products/cqc.html
AI-safe MCP: https://cqc-provider-mcp-production.up.railway.app/ai/mcp
Commercial MCP: https://cqc-provider-mcp-production.up.railway.app/mcp

### 3. UK Premises Licence Preflight
Scope: Licensing Act 2003 triggers and supported local-authority policy preflight.
Human workflow: https://uk-premises-licence-mcp-production.up.railway.app/licensing-report?src=regevidencehub
Human action: start the structured premises-licensing report workflow; the current report offer is confirmed before payment.
Brand product URL: https://regevidencehub.com/products/premises.html
AI-safe MCP: https://uk-premises-licence-mcp-production.up.railway.app/ai/mcp
Commercial MCP: https://uk-premises-licence-mcp-production.up.railway.app/mcp

### 4. England Works Watch
Scope: Skilled Worker sponsor change-impact preflight and official-source monitoring.
Human workflow: https://england-works-watch-production.up.railway.app/monitoring-report?src=regevidencehub
Human action: start Sponsor Monitoring Report; current published human/business offer is £49 for repeated access during a 30-day entitlement period, no subscription.
Brand product URL: https://regevidencehub.com/products/works.html
AI-safe MCP: https://england-works-watch-production.up.railway.app/ai/mcp
Commercial MCP: https://england-works-watch-production.up.railway.app/mcp
